title: NAP Solutions
description: NAP Solutions provides an AI-powered receptionist that answers your business calls 24/7. It books appointments, handles inquiries, reschedules, cancels, and escalates to your team when needed - all without any human staff required.

I was responsible for creating the brand identity and designing the website. The design direction was inspired by the idea of a 'digital concierge' - a service that is both professional and approachable, with a touch of warmth and personality. I took direct inspiration from the PSP and Apple's liquid glass design language to create a sleek and modern aesthetic that is both functional and visually appealing. The website features a clean and intuitive layout.
